title: Fully Automated Screening Workflow with Smart EPU
content: Single Particle Analysis (SPA) acquisition automation has significantly advanced, leading to more efficient and autonomous workflows. However, the primary bottleneck in improving overall throughput remains the screening of suitable samples for imaging [1]. This process often requires several hours of microscope and operator time to evaluate different grids and capture sample images. Each grid demands imaging and analysis of varying ice conditions at both the grid square and foil hole levels.
